description: This file implements database driver classes for SQLite using Web Workers and shared services, specifically for the Notesnook project. It includes classes for multi-tab and single-tab drivers, connection management, and query execution.

classes.name: WaSqliteWorkerMultipleTabDriver
classes.description: Driver class for managing SQLite connections across multiple browser tabs using shared worker services.

classes.name: WaSqliteWorkerSingleTabDriver
classes.description: Driver class for managing SQLite connection within a single browser tab using a dedicated Web Worker.

classes.name: WaSqliteWorkerConnection
classes.description: Represents a database connection that executes queries via a Web Worker or remote worker interface, with mutex-based sequential execution control.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the driver, setting up shared services or Web Workers as needed.

methods.name: acquireConnection
methods.description: Acquires a database connection, ensuring proper initialization and mutex locking.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the driver, closing connections or workers.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the database or worker resources.

methods.name: #initialize
methods.description: Performs initialization tasks if needed, such as running setup functions.
